$sources: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.5.1 (wind: risk-category maps, no importance factor)
source: ASCE 7-22 Table 1.5-1 risk categories; Table 1.5-2 Ie; wind speeds by risk category (Sec 26.5.1), so the wind importance is 1.0

I.description: Risk category I: low risk to human life on failure (agricultural, minor storage)

II.description: Risk category II: all buildings not in I, III or IV

III.description: Risk category III: substantial risk to human life (assembly over 300, schools, health care without emergency surgery)

IV.description: Risk category IV: essential facilities (hospitals with surgery or emergency treatment, fire, rescue and police stations, shelters)

sources.categories: ASCE 7-22 Table 1.5-1; Ie: Table 1.5-2; windImportance 1.0: ASCE 7-22 Ch 26 has no wind importance factor, the basic wind speed V of the risk category's map (Sec 26.5.1) carries it
